notes: Own H2 isotherms at -196 C up to ~1 bar on KOH-activated cellulose-acetate-derived carbons, ZIF-8-derived carbon, and their PVA-bound pellets (Fig. 1c, 2c, 8e-f; Tables 1-3, S1-S7). The paper names the instrument (BELSORP-Max II, a manometric gas-adsorption analyser) but does not name the method as 'volumetric' in words; gas-phase uptake by this analyser is read as volumetric for I1. Pellets contain ~10-14 wt% polymer binder (main pp. 11-12); carbon remains the majority component. Table 4 values for other materials are quoted from other work; the paper's own values are new. No retraction notice, no review/thesis form, no statement that the uptake values were published before (ref. 27 CA-4700 value of 3.9 wt% is cited, not re-reported as this work's data).
